title: Robo-Rally 4x4
author: Dashiel
rules:
PUZZLE:

Solve in SudokuPad

RULES:

Normal 4×4 sudoku rules apply.

The grid is the robot's program: the 16 digits are executed in reading order (row 1 left to right, then row 2, …).

1 = move one cell forward, 2 = move one cell backward (without turning), 3 = turn 90° right, 4 = turn 90° left (also shown above the grid).

The robot starts in the top-left cell facing right (blue arrow). It must stop on checkpoint 1 (green circle) at the end of a command, and after all 16 commands it must stand on the finish (red circle 2 with the checkered flag). It may pass through these cells at other times.

After every command the board acts (turn order also shown right of the grid):

• A conveyor belt moves a robot standing on it one cell along its arrows. A robot carried onto the curve turns with the belt.

• Then a robot on a turntable turns 90° in the arrow's direction (green: left, orange: right).

A robot moving into the striped wall stays where it is. The robot must never leave the board and must never enter the hole.

INSPIRATION:

I had the idea for a long while to combine sudoku with the board game RoboRally or RoboRacer. This is my first attempt, using a 4×4 as a starter. Please give feedback whether this is interesting and worth pursuing.

Also, I have no idea how hard it is, especially if you have never played the game ;)
solutionCode: Solution code: Digits of rows 1 and 2 (left to right), followed by the direction the robot faces at the finish as seen on the image: U (up), D (down), L (left) or R (right). Example: 12341234U
